messages:
Sam: Hey — noticed p50 for /v1/generate dropped ~40ms in the dashboard after the quota-label change. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
Ellie: I see that. Is this the p50 that the UI shows or the endpoint breakdown? My hunch: when we added quota_label as a primary rollup tag, some samples moved into a new bucket (quota-proxy) so the composite median shifted.
Dmitri: Can you paste the dashboard query so we can compare buckets?
Sam: Sure — the widget query (simplified):
```
from latency_rollups
where endpoint="/v1/generate" and timeframe="5m" and tag in ("route:default","quota_label:free")
group by sample_origin
select p50(latency_ms)
```
Sam: UI widget shows p50=80ms but the endpoint breakdown tile shows p50=120ms for sample_origin=gateway. The widget seems to be using the merged rollup which ended up dominated by quota-proxy samples.
Ira: That matches the change I made to promote quota_label priority in rollup keys last week. The merge heuristics pick a dominant tag which can flip the provenance. Might be causing the p50 inversion.
Ellie: Quick repro: hit the console API with sample_origin filters:
```
GET /api/metrics/query?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate&rollup=merged&sample_origin=all
```
Then compare results for `sample_origin=gateway` vs `sample_origin=quota-proxy`. The medians diverge by ~30-40ms.
Dmitri: Short-term mitigation: force the dashboard widget to scope `sample_origin=gateway` or add `provenance=server` override. Longer term: we should attach rollup provenance metadata so the UI can display which contributing bucket produced the shown p50.
Sam: I can push a quick widget patch to force `sample_origin=gateway` for the team dashboard. But agree we need platform-side provenance. This is also causing some SLO alerts to misfire because alert queries hit the merged series.
Ira: Action: platform adds `rollup_provenance` attribute to merged time series (deterministic priority: gateway > quota-proxy > cache). I'll pick this up. Filing ticket now. Also we should avoid changing rollup key priorities without a migration path.
Ellie: UX idea: widget header should show "sources: gateway (60%), quota-proxy (40%)" and let you click to expand contributing buckets with counts. That will reduce future confusion.
Sam: Owners: dashboard patch -> Sam. Platform ticket -> Ira. SLO temporary tweak -> Dmitri (set alert to query gateway samples explicitly).
console-bot: Created PLAT-1987: "attach rollup_provenance to merged metrics and expose contributing-buckets" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-1987 :white_check_mark:
Dmitri: I'll update the SLO query and open the PR for the alert rule change, tag @oncall.
Sam: Deployed quick dashboard patch (rev 3f4b) — p50 now shows "provenance: gateway" in header. Watching for noise.
Ellie: :thumbsup: Nice work. Let's add a note in the rollback playbook and review rollup-key priority changes in the next platform RFC.
